primary_policy: One material observation per evidence family; split claims before cross-source synthesis.

requirements: Use MIXED for interpretive conflict/argument synthesis; DERIVED or MIXED for COMPARATIVE
multi_family_exception.same_family_multiple_ids: Use the single matching family, never MULTI_SOURCE.

FACT.check: Existing strict direct string-token support; no inferred fact, no numerical or interpretive wording.

NUMERICAL_FACT.check: Existing exact field/value/unit numeric whitelist; family alone cannot establish support.

INTERPRETATION.check: Existing interpretive framing, nonempty valid citations, compatible families and strict numerical grounding.

COMPARATIVE.required_families: At least two families with both compared sources cited.

generation_support: DIRECT only for explicit source observation
RISK.requirement: Cite actual risk/conflict source; split unrelated families.

generation_support: DIRECT only for explicit source observation

UNCERTAINTY.requirement: Cite actual conflict, absence or uncalibrated state; existing exact uncited argument-abstention exception remains.

scope_notes: Regime belongs to TECHNICAL; quality belongs to MARKET_DATA where already exposed.
Do not invent PIPELINE, AGENT, REGIME or QUALITY namespaces absent from the agent catalog.
RISK/LIMITATION/UNCERTAINTY generation guidance is narrower; legacy validators were not relaxed or broadly rewritten.
Deterministic type/lineage/numeric guards are not universal semantic entailment.
